nowPlaying.label: Now Playing
nowPlaying.emptyBody: Open audio files, drop them here, or paste a link.

errors.mpvMissingHint: Install mpv, or run npm run fetch-sidecars when building from source.

settings.title: Settings
settings.refractionUnsupported: This engine can't render refraction, so glass uses blur and highlights instead.
settings.artworkAccentHint: Tints the interface with the cover of the playing track. Some themes keep their own accent.
settings.backdropPulseHint: The background swells gently with the music’s loudness and beats. Like all of its motion, it stops with Reduce Motion or power saving.
settings.powerSavingHint: Turns off blur, refraction and animations.
settings.liquidGlassUnsupported: Liquid Glass needs macOS 26 or later.
settings.liquidGlassFallback: Liquid Glass isn't available here, so vibrancy is used.

library.title: Library
library.removeFolderConfirm: Remove “{{path}}” from the library? The files stay on disk, but play counts and playlist entries of its songs are lost.
library.noFolders: No folders yet. Add the folder where you keep your music.
library.watchHint: Folders are watched: new, changed and deleted files show up by themselves.
library.insideFolder: This folder is already in your library as part of “{{folder}}”.
library.addOpenedFiles: Add opened files to the library
library.addOpenedFilesHint: Files you open or drop join the library as single songs, with favorites, history and playlists. A folder added later takes them in.
library.splitArtistsHint: Credits like "A feat. B", "A, B", "A & B" or "A x B" become separate artists. Tags with several artist values are always taken as they are.
library.exceptionsHint: One per line. Well-known names such as "Tyler, The Creator" and "Simon & Garfunkel" are kept whole anyway.

downloads.title: Downloads

formatHints.original: The site’s own audio (usually Opus or M4A), not re-encoded: the best quality.
formatHints.flac: Converted to FLAC: lossless container, but no better than the original.

downloads.templateHint: Use {artist}, {title}, {album} and {year}; an empty value goes with its separator. / makes folders.
downloads.ytDlpVersion: Version {{version}}. Sites change often; update when links stop working.
downloads.ytDlpMissing: yt-dlp wasn’t found, so links can’t be played or downloaded.
downloads.ffmpegMissing: FFmpeg wasn’t found: downloads need it.
downloads.cookiesHint: For age-restricted and sign-in-only videos: yt-dlp acts as you, signed in to the site in this browser. Cookies are read on your computer and only sent to the site they belong to. On macOS, Safari's need Full Disk Access for Vitra; Chrome asks for Keychain access.
downloads.cookiesNoAccess: Vitra can't read Safari's cookies: macOS keeps them from apps without Full Disk Access. Allow Vitra in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access, then restart it.

lyrics.title: Lyrics
lyrics.visibleHint: In Now Playing, the side panel and the mini player. The microphone button in the control bar brings them back.
lyrics.onlineHint: When a song has no lyrics, look them up on LRCLIB (lrclib.net). The song’s title, artist, album and length are sent there.
lyrics.translationHint: Lyrics sometimes carry a translation under each line.

mini.title: Mini Player
mini.sizeHint: You can also drag its edges; each mode keeps its own size.
mini.opacityHint: How much of the glass behind it shows; the artwork, text and buttons stay solid.
mini.opacityLinux: Linux windows aren't see-through, so this changes nothing here.
mini.overFullScreenHint: macOS only lets apps without a Dock icon float over another app's full screen, so Vitra's icon goes away while the mini player is its only window.
mini.clickThroughHint: Clicks go to the windows below. Hold {{key}} over the mini player to use it.
mini.clickThroughLinux: Clicks go to the windows below. To use the mini player again, switch this off here.
mini.hideMainWindowHint: Like Apple Music's MiniPlayer: the main window comes back when you close the mini player or click the Dock icon.

settings.vinylHint: Covers become vinyl records that turn while music plays. “As in Theme” follows the theme; the disc button on a big cover switches it too.
settings.vinylSpeedHint: How fast records turn while music plays: a record player’s 33⅓, 45 or 78, or anything from 5 to 78. Records stand still with Reduce Motion.

trayHint.macos: The track, playback buttons, the mini player and Quit. Closing the window keeps the music playing; ⌘Q or Quit Vitra quits.
trayHint.other: The track, playback buttons, the mini player and Quit. While it is on, closing the window keeps the music playing here.

general.trayUnavailable: This desktop has no place for it: install the AppIndicator library (libayatana-appindicator3).
general.globalHint: Play, pause or skip while another app is in front: set them in Keyboard Shortcuts.

library.emptyBody: Add a folder with music. Vitra keeps it up to date as files change.
library.searchHint: Search by title, artist, album or lyrics.
library.noFavoritesBody: Mark songs with ♥ to collect them here.
library.emptyPlaylistBody: Add songs from their context menu.
library.deletePlaylistConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? The songs stay in your library.
library.removeOneConfirm: Remove “{{title}}” from the library? The file stays on disk, but its play count and playlist entries are lost.
library.removeManyConfirm_one: Remove {{count}} song from the library? The files stay on disk, but play counts and playlist entries are lost.
library.removeManyConfirm_other: Remove {{count}} songs from the library? The files stay on disk, but play counts and playlist entries are lost.
library.removeLinkConfirm: Remove “{{title}}” from the library? Its play count and playlist entries are lost.
library.removeLinksConfirm_one: Remove {{count}} link from the library? Play counts and playlist entries are lost.
library.removeLinksConfirm_other: Remove {{count}} links from the library? Play counts and playlist entries are lost.

queue.title: Queue
queue.emptyBody: Play an album or a playlist, or add songs with Play Next.

tags.title: Edit Tags
tags.notWritable: Tags of this file format can't be edited.
tags.yearInvalid: Enter a year such as 1999, or leave it empty.
tags.linkHint: This is a link, not a file: your changes stay in Vitra's library, and what the site says about the track later won't replace them. Downloading it writes them into the file.
tags.restoreConfirm: Drop your corrections and take the title, artists and album from the link's page again?

links.title: Open Link
links.placeholder: Paste a link to a song, playlist or radio stream
links.hint: YouTube, YouTube Music, SoundCloud, links to audio files and internet radio (.m3u, .pls, streams). You can also paste a link anywhere in the window.
links.importHint: Playing or importing adds the playlist to the sidebar; its songs fill in as their details arrive.

errors.invalid: That doesn’t look like a web link.
errors.ytDlpMissing: yt-dlp wasn’t found. It plays links from YouTube, SoundCloud and other sites.
errors.timeout: The site didn’t answer in time. Try again later.
errors.ageRestricted: This video is age-restricted. To play it, sign in to the site in your browser and choose that browser in Settings → Downloads → Cookies from browser.
errors.signIn: The site asks to sign in. Sign in to it in your browser and choose that browser in Settings → Downloads → Cookies from browser.
errors.cookies: Couldn't read the browser's cookies. Check that the browser is installed and you are signed in; on macOS, Safari's cookies need Full Disk Access for Vitra (System Settings → Privacy & Security).

import.title: Import Playlist
import.placeholder: Paste a link to a playlist or album on Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer or Yandex Music — or tracks, one per line: Artist — Title
import.hint: Tracks your library has play at once; the others are looked for on YouTube Music in the background. Playlist files: M3U, XSPF, the Music app’s XML, CSV from Exportify, Soundiiz or TuneMyMusic. VK: open the playlist in your browser, select all, copy and paste here.
import.partial_one: “{{name}}” is imported with the {{count}} track the page shows. For all of them: open the playlist in Spotify, select its tracks (⌘A or Ctrl+A), copy (⌘C or Ctrl+C) and paste here.
import.partial_other: “{{name}}” is imported with the first {{count}} tracks the page shows. For all of them: open the playlist in Spotify, select its tracks (⌘A or Ctrl+A), copy (⌘C or Ctrl+C) and paste here.

music.empty: The Music app has no playlists of yours.
music.hint: Songs from your Music library play at once; songs from Apple Music’s catalogue are looked for on YouTube Music.

import.missing: Not found: use Find… to look for it
import.doubtful: Maybe not the right track: choose another

progress.looking_one: Looking for {{count}} of {{total}} tracks on YouTube Music…
progress.looking_other: Looking for {{count}} of {{total}} tracks on YouTube Music…

status.queued: waiting while another playlist's tracks are looked for…
status.rateLimited: YouTube Music asked to slow down: trying again in {{seconds}} s.
status.offline: YouTube Music doesn't answer: trying again in {{seconds}} s.
status.cookiesSafari: Vitra can't read Safari's cookies, which YouTube asked for. Give Vitra Full Disk Access (System Settings → Privacy & Security) or choose another browser in Settings → Links & Downloads.
status.cookies: Vitra can't read {{browser}}'s cookies, which YouTube asked for. Check that {{browser}} is installed and you're signed in to YouTube, or choose another browser in Settings → Links & Downloads.
status.ytDlpMissing: yt-dlp wasn't found, so tracks can't be looked for on YouTube Music. Settings → Links & Downloads shows where Vitra looks for it.
status.signIn: YouTube asks to sign in. Choose the browser you're signed in to YouTube with in Settings → Links & Downloads → Cookies from browser.

find.title: Find the Track
find.searching: Searching the library and YouTube Music…
find.nothing: Nothing found. Try other words: the artist and the title are enough.

errors.noTracks: No tracks found in the text. Write one per line: Artist — Title.
errors.notList: Vitra can’t read a playlist from this link. Copy the playlist’s tracks and paste them instead.
errors.shortLink: The short link leads somewhere Vitra doesn’t know. Open it in the browser and copy the full link.
errors.timeout: The service didn’t answer in time. Try again later.
errors.musicGone: This playlist is no longer in the Music app.
errors.vk: VK shows playlists only to signed-in visitors: open the playlist in your browser, select all (⌘A or Ctrl+A), copy and paste here.
errors.notFound: The service has no such playlist. Is the link complete?
errors.private: The playlist is private. Make it public, or copy its tracks and paste them here.
errors.yandexPrivate: Yandex Music shows this playlist only to its owner. Choose the browser you’re signed in to Yandex with in Settings → Downloads → Cookies from browser, or make the playlist public.
errors.unreadable: The page can’t be read right now. Copy the playlist’s tracks and paste them here.
errors.offline: Couldn’t reach the service. Check the connection.
errors.musicAccess: Vitra can’t read the Music library. Allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Media & Apple Music.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.emptyBody: Download songs from links with Download in their menu or in the link dialog.

lyrics.title: Lyrics
lyrics.nothingPlaying: Lyrics of the playing song show up here.
lyrics.missingOffline: Add them yourself, or look them up on LRCLIB.
lyrics.missingOnline: LRCLIB doesn’t have them either. You can add them yourself.

editor.title: Lyrics
editor.placeholder: Paste or type the lyrics, one line per line. LRC with [mm:ss.xx] times works too.

hints.tags: Written into the song file. A backup copy of the file is kept first.
hints.file: Saved as {{file}} next to the song.
hints.library: Kept in Vitra’s library; the file isn’t changed.

editor.confirmTags: Write the lyrics into “{{file}}”? A backup copy of the file is kept in Vitra’s data folder.
editor.discard: Discard your changes to these lyrics?
editor.untimed_one: {{count}} line has no time yet and will be left out.
editor.untimed_other: {{count}} lines have no time yet and will be left out.
editor.syncHint: Press Space as each line starts. Backspace takes the last tap back; ↑ and ↓ move the highlight. Click a line to start from it.

themes.layoutQuestion: “{{name}}” comes with its own layout of the window. Use it?
themes.replaceQuestion: A theme called “{{name}}” is installed already. Replace it?
themes.invalid:
This file doesn’t follow Vitra’s theme format:
{{error}}
themes.cssCleaned:
Parts of the theme’s custom.css were left out, since they would load things from outside the theme:
{{list}}

themeEditor.title: Theme Editor
themeEditor.invalid:
The theme can’t be saved yet:
{{error}}
themeEditor.name: Name
themeEditor.author: Author
themeEditor.refractionHint: Only Windows draws refraction; macOS and Linux show the blur and the highlight.
themeEditor.includeLayoutHint: Whoever installs the theme is asked whether to use its layout.
themeEditor.cssHint: Restyles anything (see docs/THEMES.md for the parts you can address); it can load only the theme’s own pictures and fonts, as url(assets/…).
themeEditor.vinylHint: Covers become round records; the playing track’s turn while it plays. Applies while Settings → Appearance → Covers as Records is “As in Theme”.
themeEditor.vinylSpeedHint: 33⅓ unless the theme says otherwise; a speed chosen in Settings → Appearance wins.

layout.title: Layout
layout.hint: Move panels between the window’s columns and bars, hide them, and keep layouts you like.
layout.showHint: Click to show, or drag it into place
layout.spectrumHint: How the level meter module draws the music; its context menu has the same choice.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Click a shortcut, then press the new keys. Esc cancels.
shortcuts.reserved: {{combo}} belongs to the system or to text editing
shortcuts.changeGlobal: Change the shortcut for {{action}} in every app
shortcuts.globalHint: Shortcuts in every app work while another app is in front; they need {{modifiers}}, or a function key.
shortcuts.needsModifier: {{combo}} would stop that key typing in every app: add {{modifiers}}
shortcuts.globalFailed: Another app already uses this shortcut
shortcuts.waylandHint: On Wayland, shortcuts in every app work only in apps that run through XWayland.

about.title: About Vitra
about.tagline: An open-source music player with a Liquid Glass look.
about.licenseText: Vitra is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later: you may use, study, share and change it.

sound.equalizerHint: Ten bands from 32 Hz to 16 kHz. Moving a band turns it on.
sound.normalizationHint: Plays every track equally loud: from ReplayGain tags where files have them, otherwise Vitra measures a track once (a link while it first plays). The music’s dynamics stay as they are. A change applies from the next track.
sound.crossfadeHint: Overlaps the end of a track with the start of the next. Tracks of one album stay gapless; skipping by hand switches at once.
